notes.title: About a little fix
notes.content:
I have made some corrections so that you can play the game comfortably.

・Minecart jump fix
You can jump even if you have fallen a little.

・Frame rate fix
I set it to work at 60fps fixed.

・Some map fix

Please let me know if you have any concerns.(´・ω・`)

notes.title: About Achievement bug Fixed
notes.content:
There was a problem that achievements were not released correctly.

・ Achievements are not released
・ Achievements will be released at the end of the game.
The above bug has been fixed.

I apologize for any inconvenience.(´・ω・`)

notes.title: About DLC bug Fixed
notes.content:
There was a problem that DLC was installed even for people who did not purchase paid DLC(RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure! - Royalty free illustrations).
The above bug has been fixed.
(There is no change in the game content)

I apologize for any inconvenience.(´・ω・`)
